precondition: A customer supplies an exact interval schedule, bounded target package and advertised operation, finite ActivityStreams object template, delivery capability identifier, timeout, and dry-run or live mode; invocation accepts the provider-authored offer under a single-use capability.
move: The provider records the accepted schedule locally. On each due occurrence it reserves one idempotency key, authors one ActivityStreams Create under its own actor and the customer-admitted capability, and invokes only the exact operation advertised by the target package. It never catches up more than the currently due occurrence.
postcondition: The provider returns a digest-bound schedule registration and later records the exact request bytes plus the target Accept, typed Reject, transport failure, or dry-run receipt for each attempted occurrence.

retirement.authority: only the registered customer carrying an exact unexpired one-use capability may retire its provider-owned schedule
retirement.effect: future run-due ticks skip the retired schedule while prior registrations, occurrences, and receipts remain append-only evidence

transportStatus: The first carrier is local stdio with exact package-operation admission and actor/capability binding. HTTP Signatures, ActivityPub federation, remote inbox discovery, and cryptographic actor authentication are not claimed.
